prompt: The ruins of an old empire, with survivors living among them.

card.name: Ashes of the Empire

site.text: Sprawling ruins of an old imperial city on existing land, with survivors' camp tucked among broken walls and toppled columns

style.text: The ruins of an old empire: weathered, mossy and cracked stone, broken columns and arches, with makeshift survivor patches of timber, cloth and lantern light

purpose.text: A settlement of survivors living among the ruins of an old empire

card.interpretation: Site is a large ruined imperial city on land that already exists, so no sculpting. Style is ruined stone with improvised survivor repairs. Purpose is a survivors' home base. Program mixes imperial ruins with a few lived-in buildings. No backstory was given, so none is added.
assumptions: Placed near by searching for suitable land
No named enemies or threats, so only a lookout and barricaded gate
Ruins are mostly imperial stone with timber patches

program.notes: Great broken hall with half a dome, fallen columns and a partly roofed corner the survivors use as a gathering place.
Timber and cloth lean-tos built into ruined walls.
Cracked imperial tower, repaired at the top as a lookout.
Forge set in a vaulted ruin, reworking salvaged metal.
Open fire under a surviving arch with long tables.
Crops grown in a collapsed courtyard, store in a patched cellar.
Broken statue of an emperor, a place of memory with vines.
Broken arch gate, barricaded with timber.
